thread:
nina: Heads up — we need to finalize the inventory resilience & spot-fallback playbook for the Q4 capacity push. Putting a draft here so we can sign off before the vendor RFQ.
aj: agreed. can you share target region mix and target utilization numbers?
maria: quick primer: goal is to expand EU + APAC, keep NA steady. Target fleet utilization 65% avg with 7-day buffer capacity for spikes.
leo: vendor lead times are 10–14 weeks for new racks, add 4w customs for APAC variant. planning math needs that buffer.
devin: reminder: Q4 OKR ties this to 99.9% inference availability for paid tiers. fallback playbook must include capacity and routing policy.
xiao: can we trade some model quantization + batching improvements for less hardware? lowering p99 token latency constraints might free ~12% capacity.
aj: rough procurement split proposal: 60% reserved (committed), 30% spot/spot-like instances, 10% cloud burst (on-demand). this reduces cost while keeping headroom. :thinking_face:
maria: sounds reasonable. for RTO we should ensure: 1) region fallback routing, 2) model-variant automatic fallback (float32->q4), 3) KV-prefix caching warmers.
leo: vendor constraint: reserved vs spot mix changes lead time; reserved requires PO upfront. can we stagger POs across 2 tranches?
nina: yes — propose tranche A (commit 50% in week 1), tranche B (remaining 50% after canary results).
devin: canary criteria we agreed earlier? need concrete pass/fail so finance will sign.
xiao: suggest canary pass if: average latency < target_lat and error rate delta < 0.5%, quality regression < 1% on eval set. we should list the eval prompt set id.
maria: putting numbers: target_lat = 125ms p95; error rate baseline = 0.2%; quality regression threshold = 1.0% absolute on regen-score set v3.
aj: operational playbook bullet points (short):
- If spot eviction > 2% over 24h, increase reserved buffer by one tranche.
- If cross-region failover triggered > 3 times in 7d, pause APAC rollout.
- If avg util > 75% for 72h, enable burst cap + throttling policy for non-SLAs.

maria: sample capacity calc:
```
# rough tokens/sec headroom calc
qps = 1200
avg_tokens = 40
tokens_per_sec = qps * avg_tokens
gpu_throughput = 200000  # tokens/sec per GPU (example)
gpus_needed = ceil(tokens_per_sec / gpu_throughput)
```

maria: applying with qps=1200, avg_tokens=40 -> tokens_per_sec=48000 -> gpus_needed=1 if gpu_throughput=200k, but realistic throughput=60k -> gpus_needed=1 (but need headroom factor 1.8) -> plan for 2 per zone.

leo: keep in mind memory-constrained model variants will change throughput numbers. include model-variant factor in RFQ.
devin: finance: we need estimated monthly run-rate delta for reserved vs spot. can infra provide a cost delta table by tranche?
aj: yes, i'll produce delta table and include vendor lead times.
nina: next steps: aj to produce cost vs lead-time spreadsheet by Friday, maria + xiao to finalize fallback triggers and canary criteria, leo to confirm vendor lead times and staging capacity windows, devin to draft PO tranche language for finance.
sre-bot: Incident reminder: last major failover (2025-11-12) showed 18% degradation in p95 in fallback — recommend pre-roll warmers.
maria: noted. i'll add warmers + cache priming to playbook.
aj: quick poll — everyone OK with tranche approach and 60/30/10 split? react with :+1: or :hand: if need discussion.
nina: please add any blocking concerns by EOD. we'll lock RFQ text Monday. :calendar:
